title: versioning operations on document models are not implemented
content:
# versioning operations on document models are not implemented

The document model operation taxonomy includes a "Versioning" category, but it is explicitly marked as not implemented. Do not use any versioning-related operations — they will fail or produce undefined behavior.

This is a known gap in these particular operations: in `packages/document-model/schemas/document-model/versioning.graphql` the four change-log inputs are declared as `type ...Input` rather than `input ...Input`, so no operations are generated from them at all.

Document-model versioning itself is *not* unsolved, though — it has first-class support through the document model registry's **upgrade manifests**, not git. Register them at build time with `ReactorBuilder.withUpgradeManifests(manifests)` or at runtime with `registerUpgradeManifests()`, then read them back with `getUpgradeManifest(documentType)`, `computeUpgradePath(documentType, from, to)`, and `getUpgradeReducer(documentType, from, from + 1)`. The registry keys modules by document type *and* version so multiple versions coexist, and each manifest describes the migration between consecutive versions.
